items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Duke Ellington's band. This was a great band, this particular band was a great band. And this was -- band was Louie Bellson, Wendell Marshall, I believe, Shorty Baker, Cooke, what's his name.

ctx.x: Willie Cooke, Willie Smith, Procope and of course Carnaby, and Paul Gonzales. Now, I have a -- I felt very close to Paul because Paul is a good guitarist. I don't know whether you realize it.
